covers: all six, inside the whole suite where k85, k106 and k77 failed

statement: k152 soak plan, frozen before the first run. Workload targeted runs the four test functions of the open cases (7 tests). Workload full runs the whole suite of the frozen inputs. Runs alternate idle and loaded, idle first. Loaded runs add 32 busy Python processes, two per logical CPU (hw.ncpu 16). The soak runs 40 targeted runs, then 6 full runs: 46 runs. The wall-clock budget is 2400 seconds. Runs not started inside the budget are recorded, not run.
